notes.title: Midnight Echoes Teaser
notes.content: [p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44751714/342e14819256abae4fe1cf45f7511a60f616cbe3.png"][/img][/p][p]Midnight Echoes is coming in the next few weeks![/p][p]Here's everything you need to know about this brand new map:[/p][p]-> It'll feature an "already seen" perk machine: the purple Exp Machine, but with some cool changes. Because this time around we don't have levels or exp no more, so you can expect a brand new powerup upgrade![/p][p]-> This map will feature 3 different sections: A giant and dense forest, a small hut full of Simon's random inventions and... Let's just say that this map is all about getting the Shadow Katalysator, which power comes from moon crystals, so yeah, you can expect something crazy coming.[/p][p]->  It'll also feature a brand new enemy type: The Shadow Demon. notes.title: Patch Notes 1.9.1.1
notes.content:
- Ammo is now way cheaper, here how it works:
[list]
- Normal guns now costs 100 points to maximize ammo. This price will increase in decimal rounds. So after round 10 it will be 200, on 20 will be 300, and going on and on. (It was 250, and would increase from 5 to 5 rounds).
- Normal guns with upgrade now costs 250 to maximize ammo. The price will also increase in decimal rounds: 10 = 500, 20 = 750, 30 = 1000 (The old price was 1000 on round 10)
- Especial guns still costs 1000 points to maximize ammo, since they are very strong, but their price will also increase from 10 to 10 rounds: 10 = 2000, 20 = 3000
[/list]

- Adressed a bug where the player could loose both guns when hitting a Laser Tower with a knife.
-> Added a new random event: The Heart Machine. You can trade 1 Full Heart for a chance of winning a random artifact or powerup.

notes.title: 1.9 Patch Notes
notes.content:
The next few months are going to be tough for me, as I am starting a new Job but I also need to keep this game updated, so a made a big update for now to keep you warm and cozy to wait for the next big update that will bring the next Map.

First I have a bad and a great new: The bad new is that I cancelled that brand new game mode "Incursions" because I though it would just cause more work for me to develop 2 modes at the same time. The Great new is that I've just fused that mode with the normal mode. So now you can be awarded with Artifacts in-game, that give you passive abilities like freezing enemies and exploding while reloading. There are also a new "event system" that will randomly spawn something for you to worry about middle-game, like a giant horde coming, or a tower that can slow you down. All of this "events" can award you with artifacts and powerups if you participate.

Here's everything that has changed:
-> Souls are now like coins, you need to collect them.
-> You can now SAVE 3 different guns and keep them to get back later on the hub (even if you die).
-> You can now use the Gun Upgrader Machine on the hub.
-> New Mission Menu
-> New Artifacts System
-> New Secret Quest Track system: You can now track the quests you are doing on each mission.
-> Forge is more random now.
-> Doors can now be permanently open, even if you extract. They only come back if you die.
-> If you extract with Power On, the power will be on again when you come back to that mission (if you didn't die before going back)
-> Some quests will change the map permanently after you've done it, even if you die.
-> Game Over screen updated.
-> There is no "Level" and "Xp" no more. Perks have no limit.

notes.title: Latest Patch (1.8.0.0)
notes.content: [p]It's finally here! you can check all that was changed now:[/p][list][*][p]HUD Improvments: The hud is way more "compatible" with Raven's Carnage vibe, with a more pixelated UI and more personality than ever. This include: Pause Menu, Game Over screen, and much more![/p][/*][*][p]Incursion Mode: Incursion mode IS NOT available YET. But, you can already get 3 artifacts FOR FREE on the Main Hub, just find them and they'll be yours.[/p][/*][*][p]GamePad: I'm working on the 100% gamepad control, for now I would say that 95% of Raven's Carnage is playable now with only a controller! (There's just 1 or 2 menus that don't support it, but I'm currently working on it)[/p][/*][/list][p]💥 - IMPORTANT CHANGES:[/p][list][*][p]Monsters Health: Monsters were totally balanced in this update. Their total life was reduced by 50%, this will make so that you can kill them with only 1 knife until round 3. This way you can focus on what's really matter: CARNAGE and SECRET QUESTS. Also: Shooting monsters will now work on a very different way: They only shoot when they are next to you, so you won't have too much bullets going on your screen, there are lots of cases when they don't even shoot because you kill them fast enough. But this comes with a "trade-off": Monster projectiles are now 2x faster, so if they shoot it will be a little harder to escape (still very possible and fair, it's just more fast). On forsaken's specificaly: The game will give priority in spawning normal monsters, so you'll see less shooting monsters on that map![/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]There's no more character selection in Raven's Carnage. "Why you did this?" I know, I know, BUT this is important because Raven is the Main Character on Raven' s Carnage Story and I want him (and you, the player) to play an ESSENCIAL role in the hole story, and so you NEED to play with Raven in order for the story to progress in the way that it feels right. Also, the "Special Power" was removed, so Raven can no more reach that "demon form". BUT HOLD ON! The other characters will still make their way to Raven's Carnage, and you'll be able to find them, in any form: Bots, npcs and etc. They'll be part of secret quests and story. Also, I'm currently working on RAVEN COSTUMES, so yeah, you'll be able to change your appearence but it still will be Raven, but every costume can give you a small special or passive abilitie, so stay tuned on that! (For example: you can earn a Raven Knight costume for finishing forsaken's quest, in the next few updates!)[/p][/*][*][p]There's no more ANTIDOTE PERK. You are no longer able to increase your max life (just by buying a perk). This was made because the Antidote perk was pretty unbalanced and I don't think I would ever find a way to fit it in the game in a way that feels natural, so I taking it out and adding a brand new PowerUp drop: Life Maximizer (it maximizes your life). But you'll still be able to increase your max life (in other ways I'm still working on)[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Coming Soon (1.8)
notes.content:
Hello! Since my next update is taking a lot of time to finish, I'm here to give you a sneak peak of what is to come in the next week:

Firstly: Yes, I've heard you, the game is extremely hard right now, and don't worry! Enemies are being COMPLETELY rebalanced, from monster type spawn rate to shoot frequency of some of them, you'll see less projectiles on the screen and monsters that feel more "Fair".

"Now, why is this update taking so long?"

-> BRAND NEW CLASSIC GAME MODE COMING: Incursions (The Original Corpse Master experiencie) it's finally making it's way to Raven's Carnage. A game mode away from the "Round-based maps" style. Here you'll need to clear endless rooms of Monsters, while collect artifacts that gives you passive abilities (you can even use these abilites on the Main Story maps)

This mode will be always included on the weekly updates, so that there's always something new to see there, it will be that mode you'll play when you get tired of waiting for the next map (that will also come very soon)

Here, take a look at some artifacts abilities:

-> Medieval Shield: Have a permanently shield that blocks projectiles on your back.

-> Ice Talisman: Creates a ice epxlosion that freezes all enemies.

-> Poisoned Potato: Raven will vomit every once in a while, and his vomit will poison enemies who step on It.

------------------------

There's even more to come: Drasticaly Hud Change 

The hud will now follow the game resolution: 320x180, meaning that it will feel more "compatible" with the game visuals, trust me, it makes A LOT of difference.

Also, I'm changing all of the hud style to match perfectly with the game, everything will feel "on the same page" following the same vibe.

It will feel like a brand new game.

--------------------------

FULL GAMEPAD SUPPORT: Yes. You'll be able to play Raven's Carnage from your couch, using your controller!

--------------------------

There's much more to come on next week update, so stay tuned!

See ya ;)

notes.content:

Rebalance:

notes.content:
This patch is the most important one for now. And it comes with a "bad" consequence:

-> In this patch, I've just implemented something that should've been done in a long time: create a cryptography system for the save file. This needs to be done so I can assure a secure "Online Leaderboards" minimizing cheaters.

-> But that comes with a problem: it means that the old save file format won't be compactible anymore in any scenario. So what's probably gonna happen is that you're going to loose your save. That's why I did this update as fast as possible so that the game is in its "early" versions with only 2 maps and not so many things to progress right now.

-> I'm REALLY sorry for doing this, and as a apology, I'll be giving a free Mp40 instead of "Sally & Larry" for the rest of the lifespan of this version (1.7.1.x).

-> ALSO: if you already have a great save file, with lots of characters unlocked, or something like that and you don't want to lose it, you can get your save file from steam and send it to me on this email: hightwattstudio@gmail.com, I'll reply as soon as possible to return a valid save file for you.

-> That's it. Stay tuned and please let me know about how the game is going. Thanks for the pacience!

notes.title: RAVEN'S CARNAGE: FIRST CHAPTER
notes.content:
Welcome to the First Chapter of Raven's Carnage. The Update that puts everything in it's right place is right here:

-> For the first time, you can progress on Raven's Carnage Story while killing thousands of demons. Every map is connected and full of secrets, containing a Main Quest that will progress you through the Story. 

-> Discover the horrors of "Hideout 116", Dr.Ashford abandoned this lab long ago, and now you need to go there to get the first Elemental Power: Light. While also trying to take advantage of Ashford's old Tech: guns that use demonic blood, Old robots that can fight by your side, and much, MUCH MORE!

-> Immerse yourself in the Medieval Age in "Forsaken", a Dark Castle Map that hides much more than meets the eye. Espectral Staffs, Vampire Potions, Knight Demons, and most important: The Fire Katalysator. It's a really dense map, with a unique soundtrack, camping spots, special enemies and most important: Boss Fight.

-> Have a talk with Dr. Ashford: You can now talk with Dr. Ashford, and you will need to, if you want his help to reunite all of the 6 Elemental Powers to save Sarah, his daughter from the Damned, (and of course, the intire universe).

-> There's much to come. The next map: Hut of The Dead is being remade with the same whim as the 2 previous maps, so stay tuned, it'll even have "Time Machine" mechanic.

-------- IMPROVEMENTS ----------
-> Lots of new guns were added. In The Forge and also in secret side quests on both maps. Most of the guns even have Upgrade side quests (you can have a peek at the achievments list).

-> Graphical improvement.

-> The Hub is bigger than ever (And it'll get even bigger within the next updates).

-> You can now heal yourself in the Hub, and also Maximize your Ammo for free.

--------------------------------------

NEXT UPDATES:
-> I'm planning on bringing more updates next month. My plan now is to deliver more updates with less content, but this way I can update the game more frequently while the new map is being crafted in the background.

-> What to expect for the next weeks: Online Leaderboard, More Characters, A New way to save your guns permanently, a new "Survival Challenge".

notes.title: PLAY THE NEW "Green Caves" MAP TODAY!
notes.content:
Surprise! I'm releasing the fourth map of Raven's Carnage today, which continues the adventure of Raven and her allies in search of the 6 elemental weapons.

In addition, the game has been HIGHLY improved in several aspects:

- Characters now have directional animations, they look much more alive.

- New weapons, (including an Ak-47 and an MP-40)

- 2 new SPECIAL weapons (eXpelis and Katalysator (Acid))

- You can now carry items! And yes, that means you can now craft weapons. For now, this new feature is only available on the Green Caves map, but it will be present in the future on previous maps and the next maps will have a HIGH emphasis on using items to get other improvements, weapons and progress in the mission.

- A new feature (exclusive to the Green Caves map), you can plant and grow plants! Plants can give you weapons, powerups, perks and even important items for the mission.

- A new and EXTREMELY useful perk that creates shields around you that deflect enemy fire. The more you buy, the more durable the shields will be.

- The game's first cutscene! Yes, you can now start immersing yourself in the story of Raven's Carnage, with the first cutscene playing right at the start of the game.

- The Hub has undergone several changes to prepare you for the upcoming updates. And yes, I'm talking about the PERMANENT progression of characters, perks, and items.

- There's much more to come! Play Raven's Carnage and destroy the demon army today!
